targets.baseline_commit_message: grade-and-repair-speech-audio: byte copies of the speech-grading plan reader and the voice-take checks (port baseline)

preserve: every stretch under -50 dBFS (20 ms RMS) for at least 60 ms becomes digital silence with 5 ms fades
quiet runs split only by a blip of up to 40 ms are bridged
a sentence that ends at full level gets a 25 ms fade-out
the cleaned take is written 24-bit; the take is only read
banned_substitutions: a denoiser in place of the gate

required_mechanisms: # bridge quiet runs split only by a short blip
sf.write(dst, y * gain[:, None], sr, subtype='PCM_24')
